independence: Canonical parsing, rolling context, finite filter basis, standardized ridge equations, KKT and statistics independently reconstructed in NumPy. GRU weights are replayed with PyTorch's GRU operator, and EWT with the frozen library, without training; these are not independent algorithm implementations.
scope: Tianjin development and CEA confirmation remain separate. No extra candidates, seeds, block lengths, tests or fits are selected by this audit.

counts.gradient_count_limitation: VP counts checked against every per-epoch logged norm. GRU positive-gradient counts are receipt values bounded by exact batch/epoch update counts; no backward retraining was performed.

limitations: One CEA source tail cannot establish generality across all carbon markets.
H20 targets overlap; circular-block percentile intervals are approximate and both20/40 sensitivities are retained.
Eight core intervals target family95 within each market. Two neural reference intervals are marginal95 only, outside that family.
Current public historical source snapshots are not certified per-day vintage archives.
VP epoch0 includes a supervised linear readout, unlike the completely fixed legacy formula.
The fixed-dynamics same-alpha diagnostic is an after-fit attribution record, not another selected competitor.
